category_title: At-risk young adolescents exhibiting school refusal, performance anxiety, and rejection of teacher authority
minimal_context: The student is in the classroom during the early weeks of the program, transitioning between activities while the teacher gives verbal instructions to the whole class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright class, it is time to transition to our next activity. Please put your current work away and listen for the next instruction.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues talking to the student next to them, completely ignoring the instruction to transition.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I need everyone to stop talking and get ready for the next task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why do we even have to learn this? I'm not doing the next task.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just follow the instructions so we can move on with the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns completely away from the teacher, resisting control and continuing to talk loudly instead of complying with the redirection.)
